Common.tagline: Organize your Secret Santa draw and email the results.

Landing.title: Your Secret Santa draw, no paper slips needed
Landing.subtitle: Add the participants, set who can't give to whom, and everyone gets their Secret Santa by email.
Landing.feature1Text: Keep couples or families from drawing each other, and even block whole groups from each other.
Landing.feature2Text: Not even the organizer can see who got whom.
Landing.feature3Text: Each participant gets an email with their match, the date and the budget.

Draws.title: My draws
Draws.emptyTitle: You don't have any draws yet
Draws.emptyText: Create your first draw and add the participants.
Draws.participantCount: {count, plural, =0 {No participants} one {# participant} other {# participants}}
Draws.deleteDescription: The draw, its participants and its restrictions will be deleted. This can't be undone.

Details.title: Draw details
Details.description: This information will appear in the email each participant receives.
Details.name: Draw name
Details.messagePlaceholder: E.g. See you at grandma's at 8 pm 🎄
Details.localeHelp: The draw emails will be sent in this language.

Participants.title: Participants
Participants.description: Add the name and email of each person taking part in the draw.
Participants.name: Name
Participants.count: {count, plural, =0 {No participants} one {# participant} other {# participants}}
Participants.minHint: {count, plural, one {# more participant} other {# more participants}} needed to draw
Participants.empty: No participants yet. Add the first one above.

Import.title: Import participants
Import.description: Upload a .csv or .txt file, or paste the list. One participant per line, with their name and email in any order.
Import.pastePlaceholder:
Ana Perez, ana@example.com
Bob Smith; bob@example.com
Import.fileTooLarge: The file is too large (max 512 KB).
Import.readyCount: {count, plural, one {# ready to import} other {# ready to import}}
Import.errorCount: {count, plural, one {# with errors} other {# with errors}}
Import.overLimit: You can only add {count} more participants to this draw.
Import.errorsHint: Rows with errors won't be imported. Fix them in the file or the text to include them.
Import.imported: {count, plural, =0 {No participants were imported} one {# participant imported} other {# participants imported}}
Import.skipped: {count, plural, one {# row was skipped} other {# rows were skipped}} (duplicate names or invalid data).

Groups.title: Groups
Groups.description: Members of the same group will never give to each other. Use it for couples, siblings or families.
Groups.empty: No groups. If you don't need restrictions, you can go to the review.
Groups.assignDescription: Choose each participant's group. A person can only be in one group.
Groups.noParticipants: Add participants in the previous step first.
Groups.restrictionsDescription: Check the pairs of groups whose members must not give to each other (in either direction).
Groups.needTwoGroups: Create at least two groups to set restrictions between them.
Groups.singleMemberHint: A one-person group doesn't restrict anything on its own.

Review.title: Final review
Review.description: Make sure everything is right before drawing.
Review.ruleSameGroup: Members of the same group don't give to each other
Review.feasible: All set: the draw is possible with these restrictions.
Review.problemTooFew: You need at least 3 participants to draw.
Review.problemNoOptions: {count, plural, one {{names} has} other {{names} have}} nobody to give to with the current restrictions.
Review.problemTooRestrictive: The restrictions make the draw impossible. Try smaller groups or fewer restrictions between groups.
Review.mailNotConfigured: Email sending isn't configured: emails will be printed to the server console instead of being sent.
Review.confirmDescription: There's no going back: the draw will be made and {count, plural, one {# participant} other {all # participants}} will be emailed their Secret Santa. You won't be able to edit the draw afterwards.

Result.successDescription: {count, plural, one {# email was sent} other {All # emails were sent}}. Every participant now knows who they're giving to.
Result.errorTitle: The draw was made, but some emails failed
Result.errorDescription: {failed} of {total} emails couldn't be sent. Check the addresses and resend them from the list below.
Result.resendFailed: Retry {count, plural, one {failed email} other {# failed emails}}
Result.resendDescription: You can fix the address before resending. The email keeps the same draw assignment.
Result.resendSummaryOk: {count, plural, one {# email resent} other {# emails resent}}
Result.privacyNote: For privacy, nobody (not even you) can see who got whom.
